args.title: Archive Note — Leo’s Approved Compass v0.1 Involvement (January 2025)
args.body:
Date: January 2025

Leo Park’s approved involvement in Compass v0.1 was limited to a lightweight first read on data/platform seams and release-discipline or event-provenance checks. His work supported testing whether renewal-risk/admin-friction evidence and the post-first-live-sync expansion prompt could be used reliably by the current owner group.

Leo was not approved as a broad product owner, and Compass was not authorized to become a dashboard, platform, or broader customer-analytics build. Any exposure beyond the current team required his seam check first. If the work began expanding into a dashboard/platform build or otherwise exceeded the narrow v0.1 seam review, its scope had to return to Morgan Chen for review. January’s center of gravity remained Mercury activation: workspace creation → first source connected → first live sync, with teammate-invite and admin-role basics.
